reason: A notification and monitoring framework that centralizes event registration, configurable delivery channels, notification history, audio feedback, and support for derived notification plugins.

summaries.zh: 用于统一注册、配置和分发会话、代理、进程及错误事件通知的 DSH 通知管理框架。
summaries.en: A DSH notification management framework for registering, configuring, and delivering session, agent, process, and error event notifications.

capabilities: Registers and routes notification events from built-in and derived plugins
Displays in-app toast notifications and optional system notifications
Writes optional notification history to memory and notifications to a configured log file
Pushes notifications to the browser over WebSocket
Plays built-in or user-configured audio URLs for notifications
Checks npm registry dist-tags for DSH package updates
